text:
ravi: CI is red on my PR #4821 after merging main. pre-commit failed with rustfmt + mypy. Seems to be a small formatting/eol churn and a mypy None/str complaint. Logs below. Anyone else seeing this?

```
rustfmt - failed: diff in src/kvcache/mod.rs
-    fn get(&mut self) -> String {\n+    fn get(&mut self) -> String {\n        ...\n}
mypy - error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type 'None', variable has type 'str') at src/serve/cache.py:47
```

jess: Link to the CI run? can grab logs.

ravi: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/384/4821 (root job). main merge was 1981200000-ish — probably pulled a windows-author commit.

ci-bot: Pre-commit summary: rustfmt failed (1 file), mypy failed (2 errors). Build 384: FAILED.

sam: can you try rerun first, sometimes the mypy env mis-picks stubs.

ravi: triggered rerun (manual). queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/384/4821/rerun

devops-bot: Rerun started by @ravi — agents: ubuntu-22 / py3.11.

ravi: rerun finished — same failures. I reproduced locally in WSL: rustfmt shows the diff, mypy shows the None/str complaint.

maya: I'm guessing EOL normalization. A windows commit earlier this week touched proto files without .gitattributes. Did you run pre-commit hooks locally before pushing?

ravi: I ran them, but on WSL the core.autocrlf is off. Looks like the repo lacks .gitattributes that force LF.

jess: quick bisect: failure introduced by commit 1981198765 (author: alex) — they changed a generated file and it appears to have CRLF.

sam: for mypy error, can you paste the snippet? might be a typing regression from a runtime sentinel change.

ravi: snippet in serve/cache.py:47 — we cache a lookup that can return None or str depending on backend. mypy used to accept Optional[str]; now a stricter stub surfaced.

maya: two fixes: 1) normalize EOLs (.gitattributes) + reformat, 2) tighten types in cache wrapper (-> Optional[str] and cast). Recommend making a tiny PR that fixes both.

ravi: doing that now — will add .gitattributes, run pre-commit, fix the annotation and push as PR 4823.

jess: if you push the PR, I can quick-review. also add a short note in the commit msg referencing the bisect/CI issue.

sam: also let's add a follow-up issue to run a CI step that normalizes EOLs before lint hooks, so this doesn't sneak through again. cc @platform.

ravi: PR 4823 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823 — contains .gitattributes + cache type fix + ran pre-commit.

ci-bot: PR 4823: pre-commit checks started.

devops-bot: PR 4823: all checks passed.

jess: reviewed and left a minor comment on the docstring, otherwise LGTM.

sam: creating follow-up issue #200: "CI: normalize line endings before hooks" with a minimal plan.

ravi: thanks all — merging PR 4823 now to unblock CI on master.

jess: :thumbsup: great fast triage.

sam: noted for retro: add a short blurb to the release notes about pre-commit EOL sensitivity.
